one_sentence_fix: Turn slide 06's coins into bokeh: drop the inner offset rim, build each cat's-eye as the soft intersection of two circles instead of a straight chord, and blur disc edges 3 to 6 px on the nearest two rows. 06 is now the frame where a zoom most clearly shows craft falling short.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The 88 discs read as stacked coins, not optical bokeh. Each has a doubled offset rim like a coin edge. The bottom-row discs (y about 1700 to 1900 display) have hard straight cat's-eye chords that look sliced. The top three rows overlap into muddy grey-gold. On a breather frame the disc field is the only thing a viewer inspects.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Remove the inner offset rim and keep one soft rim brightening. Build the cat's-eye as the blurred intersection of two circles. Apply a 3 to 6 px full-res edge blur scaled with CoC, and vary disc size continuously with depth instead of in lattice steps.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The lower half reads as alternating near-black and brown stripes: the lee faces are too dark, and the near desk tops are flat slabs. The rings are stroked bullseye targets. Dark vertical bars remain under the warm page band at the bottom edge (y about 1880 to 2000 display).
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Double the warm bounce on the lee faces so no desk band falls below about L* 15. Replace the bottom bars with soft round defocused page blobs. Give the nearest two ring rows a filled emissive core with a soft bloom instead of a stroked target.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The walnut renders as bold, wavy, converging zebra lines that read as raked sand. The shade's right end cap is a flat dark half-disc with no interior bounce. The shade's top silhouette shows stair-stepping near x 1000 to 1040 display. The stand and page stack have little grounding beyond faint AO.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Cut grain contrast by about 60 percent and break it with low-frequency figure noise. Add a warm interior bounce and rim to the end cap, and supersample the shade silhouette. Add a soft stem shadow radiating from the bulb across the pool.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The AM halftone breaks into dash and x-shaped cells in the lower-right corner (about x 1100 to 1600, y 1700 to 2000 display) as the cells coarsen toward the lens.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Clamp every cell to a round dot with a minimum radius at all sizes.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The cover has no focal light. The dossier's tungsten lamp pool at the lower right is absent, so the art is an evenly lit grid of cards competing with itself at thumb.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Composite a warm tungsten falloff into the lower right across the walnut and near pages, about 1.4 stops over the grid, so the eye lands there after the quote.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The glow edge is fixed. The near page trapezoids are still flat single-gradient fills with a notch, much simpler than the shaded ribbons crossing them, and they repeat the page grid of 01, 02 and 05.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Keep two rows of pages deep in fog, edge-lit only, with a soft contact shadow under each.
